title: Kotoba Colosseum visibility & release refresh
changes: Made Kotoba Colosseum visible from Activity Village in both map and classic views.
Removed the village cat from Activity Village.
Added a release manager so the header version badge checks for updates and refreshes app files.
Clicking the version badge now clears Kaishi app caches, asks the service worker to update, and reloads from a cache-busted URL.
Moved all service-worker release asset cache keys to the single 11.3.1 version value.
Kept existing learner progress and cloud data untouched during refresh.
